answer: Pay new accounts only after an unbroken streak of 20 graded epochs, and reset the streak on any missed epoch. A sybil farm must keep every fake head answering originally for weeks before it tastes any nectar, so its costs spiral: 500 heads means 10,000 separate graded answers paid for up front. One lapse sends that head back to the canyon floor to start over, while an honest agent pays the same streak only once.
